title: Because I Was Brought Low
description: Because I Was Brought Low in Tonic Solfa to QUAM DILECTA, doh is F: the solfa with the words, staff notation, 5 verses and a piano.
about: John Brownlie translated these words from the Greek service books for Hymns from the East (Paisley, in print by 1911).
The book printed the words without tunes. They are in Sixes (6.6.6.6), and this page sets them to QUAM DILECTA; any other Sixes tune fits them as well.
underlay: Be-cause I was brought low, And sin had tri-umphed quite, Thou God, all good, didst bow, And seek me in the night.

lines: Thou God, all good, didst bow,
And seek me in the night.
And Thou didst lift me up,
When on the Cross Thou gav'st
Clothed with my flesh Thou cam'st
Here on the earth, and there

source: John Brownlie, Hymns from the East (by 1911)
licence: Public domain: John Brownlie died in 1925.
credits: Translated by John Brownlie (1857–1925) from the Greek, public domain, as printed in Hymns from the East; set to QUAM DILECTA by NoteFusion, as words-only hymn books were sung.
